id: \rVisquez: Welcome to the Vermilion Gym.
en: \rVisquez: Welcome to the Vermilion Gym.
it: \rVisquez: Benvenuto alla Palestra di Aranciopoli.

id: \rVisquez: Welcome to the Vermilion Gym. Or should I say welcome back?
en: \rVisquez: Welcome to the Vermilion Gym. Or should I say welcome back?
it: \rVisquez: Benvenuto alla Palestra di Aranciopoli. O dovrei dire bentornato?

id: \rI recognized your name right away. Lt. Surge told me all about his battle with you. It's a shame he's away training right now.
en: \rI recognized your name right away. Lt. Surge told me all about his battle with you. It's a shame he's away training right now.
it: \rHo riconosciuto subito il tuo nome. Il Lt. Surge mi ha raccontato tutto della vostra lotta. Peccato che ora sia via ad allenarsi.

id: \rRegardless, my Raichu and I are honored to be your first opponent. Let's begin.
en: \rRegardless, my Raichu and I are honored to be your first opponent. Let's begin.
it: \rIn ogni caso, io e il mio Raichu siamo onorati di essere i tuoi primi avversari. Cominciamo.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 3,763.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 3,763.
it: Smart Rotom: In base ai risultati, la tua posizione in classifica ora è 3.763.

id: \rVisquez: You've only improved from when you were last here. I can't wait to tell Lt. Surge of our battle.
en: \rVisquez: You've only improved from when you were last here. I can't wait to tell Lt. Surge of our battle.
it: \rVisquez: Sei solo migliorato dall'ultima volta che sei stato qui. Non vedo l'ora di raccontare al Lt. Surge della nostra lotta.

id: \bI'm ready to battle you with my all.
en: \bI'm ready to battle you with my all.
it: \bSono pronto a sfidarti con tutte le mie forze.

id: \bIt's not easy opening the door.\nLt. Surge was always famous for his cautious nature in the Army.
en: \bIt's not easy opening the door.\nLt. Surge was always famous for his cautious nature in the Army.
it: \bNon è facile aprire la porta.\nNell'esercito il Lt. Surge era famoso per la sua prudenza.

id: Nothing.
en: Nothing.
it: Niente.

id: The switch activated.
en: The switch activated.
it: L'interruttore si è attivato.

id: \bLt. Surge: Hmmph. You don't look like much of a challenge to me, but I guess I'll battle you anyways.
en: \bLt. Surge: Hmmph. You don't look like much of a challenge to me, but I guess I'll battle you anyways.
it: \bLt. Surge: Hmmph. Non mi sembri chissà che sfida, ma immagino che lotterò con te lo stesso.

id: \bPrepare to be electocuted, shrimp.
en: \bPrepare to be electocuted, shrimp.
it: \bPreparati a restare fulminato, pivello.

id: \bLt. Surge: You've earned the Thunder Badge.
en: \bLt. Surge: You've earned the Thunder Badge.
it: \bLt. Surge: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Tuono.

id: \bHere, have this TM too.
en: \bHere, have this TM too.
it: \bEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \bTM24 contains Thunderbolt. It does damage and has a chance to paralyze the opponent.
en: \bTM24 contains Thunderbolt. It does damage and has a chance to paralyze the opponent.
it: \bLa MT24 contiene Fulmine. Infligge danni e può paralizzare l'avversario.

id: \bLt. Surge: You're better than I thought, kid. I can't wait to battle with you again someday.
en: \bLt. Surge: You're better than I thought, kid. I can't wait to battle with you again someday.
it: \bLt. Surge: Sei meglio di quanto pensassi, ragazzo. Non vedo l'ora di sfidarti di nuovo, un giorno.

id: \bA man of the sea never turns down an opponent.
en: \bA man of the sea never turns down an opponent.
it: \bUn uomo di mare non rifiuta mai una sfida.

id: \bLt. Surge installed the traps in the Gym himself.
en: \bLt. Surge installed the traps in the Gym himself.
it: \bLe trappole della Palestra le ha installate il Lt. Surge in persona.

id: \bLt. Surge uses Electric type Pokémon. They are weak aganst only the Ground type.
en: \bLt. Surge uses Electric type Pokémon. They are weak aganst only the Ground type.
it: \bIl Lt. Surge usa Pokémon di tipo Elettro. Sono deboli solo contro il tipo Terra.

id: \bThey are strong against Flying and Water. Flying, Electric, and Steel moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Flying and Water. Flying, Electric, and Steel moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Volante e Acqua. Anche le mosse Volante, Elettro e Acciaio non fanno loro molto danno.

id: \bYou might have what it takes.
en: \bYou might have what it takes.
it: \bForse hai la stoffa giusta.

id: \bVisquez might be a stand in, but she's the real deal.
en: \bVisquez might be a stand in, but she's the real deal.
it: \bVisquez sarà anche una sostituta, ma è il vero affare.

id: \bIf you win I will give you a hint.
en: \bIf you win I will give you a hint.
it: \bSe vinci ti darò un indizio.

id: \bLt. Surge said he hid door switches inside something.
en: \bLt. Surge said he hid door switches inside something.
it: \bIl Lt. Surge ha detto di aver nascosto gli interruttori delle porte dentro qualcosa.

id: \bVisquez won't go easy on you.
en: \bVisquez won't go easy on you.
it: \bVisquez non ci andrà piano con te.

id: \bVisquez is already ranked in the 2,000s. She'll reach the Great Class in no time.
en: \bVisquez is already ranked in the 2,000s. She'll reach the Great Class in no time.
it: \bVisquez è già in classifica tra i primi 2.000. Raggiungerà la Classe Super in un attimo.

id: \bYou're the one that beat Visquez. Don't think I'll be easier just because I work for her.
en: \bYou're the one that beat Visquez. Don't think I'll be easier just because I work for her.
it: \bSei tu quello che ha battuto Visquez. Non pensare che io sia più facile solo perché lavoro per lei.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 901.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 901.
it: Smart Rotom: In base ai risultati, la tua posizione in classifica ora è 901.

id: \bI can't catch a break.
en: \bI can't catch a break.
it: \bNon me ne va bene una.
